notes: A is NPBench's initialize() data at preset T {'I': 15, 'J': 15, 'K': 10}. Changed for Q32: wcon is NPBench's draw times 0.1. With wcon uniform in [0, 1) and dtr_stage = 0.15, the Thomas sweep divides by bcol - ccol[k-1] * acol, which reaches 3.7e-5 on A (1.1e-4 on B) and amplifies Q32 rounding to 1.1e-3. With |wcon| < 0.15 the tridiagonal system is strictly diagonally dominant (|bcol| > |acol| + |ccol|) whatever the signs, and every divisor stays above 0.1; the computation is unchanged. B is a seeded perturbation of A (numpy RandomState(4116720)): noise 10 % of the largest magnitude; integer arrays redrawn in their range.
